description: rsa_modulus_byte_len calls der_peel_tlv then der_tlv_value_len on the same input — both parse the same tag+length bytes. The first call's only purpose is validation, but der_tlv_value_len already returns None on tag mismatch. Remove the der_peel_tlv call entirely. File: pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs lines 271-279.
title: cabf: rsa_modulus_byte_len parses INTEGER TLV twice
